outfits.name: Casual — Campus & Boba Runs
outfits.prompt: Base (swimwear) — A vivid coral two-piece bikini with a sporty bandeau-style top and matching cheeky-cut bottoms, built for an athletic frame. A thin gold chain necklace resting against the collarbone, a single bold gold hoop earring, and a small gold stud in the upper cartilage piercing. Barefoot on warm sand, nothing else needed., Casual — Campus & Boba Runs — Black high-waisted biker shorts sitting snug at mid-thigh, paired with a cropped heather-grey hoodie cut just above the navel with the sleeves pushed to the elbows. A faded, oversized denim jacket worn open over the hoodie, cuffs fraying slightly. White crew socks with low-top canvas sneakers in coral. A thick gold hoop earring, and a small gold stud in the upper cartilage., Studio — Industrial Design Workshop — A well-worn olive-green canvas apron tied over a plain white fitted t-shirt, the shirt tucked into high-waisted charcoal utility trousers with multiple pockets and a taped hem. A black elastic hair tie pulling braids into a higher ponytail. Thick-soled black leather work boots laced up over black ankle socks. A pair of clear protective safety glasses pushed up onto the forehead, a gold bangle still on the left wrist, and the gold hoop earring., Night Out — Club & Drinks — A fitted black mock-neck bodysuit with long sleeves, tucked into high-waisted wide-leg trousers in deep burgundy satin that drape and move. A cropped structured blazer in the same black as the bodysuit, worn open, shoulders sharp. Strappy black heeled sandals with an ankle strap. Layered gold necklaces — one chunky chain, one finer pendant — stacked gold bangles on both wrists, oversized gold hoop earrings, and a deep nude-matte lip color., Loungewear — Apartment with Maya — An oversized faded black t-shirt with a cracked graphic print, knotted at the side hem, over loose grey jersey sweatpants with a drawstring waist. Bare feet. A scrunchie in a clashing coral holding the braids up messily. A thin gold chain necklace and the single gold hoop earring still in.
